summary: Scope validation completed for icon-mock + testID hardening. Lint, typecheck, verify:release (OK_FULL with provided EDGE credentials), and targeted smoke/main-screen Jest suites are green. Applied a minimal Jest mock extension to cover Ionicons subpath imports and remove prior act() warning noise.

integration_issues.flow: Jest process shutdown after targeted suites
integration_issues.issue: Jest reports open async handles ('Jest did not exit one second after the test run has completed') despite all tests passing.

action_items: Optional: run a dedicated open-handle pass (e.g., --detectOpenHandles) to cleanly eliminate Jest shutdown warning.
Keep global vector icon mocks aligned for both package root and subpath imports when adding new icon usage patterns.
critical_code_review_comments: Root cause for prior icon-related test noise: global mock covered '@expo/vector-icons' but not '@expo/vector-icons/Ionicons' direct imports used in CredentialsWizard components.
Added testID markers on reviewed main screens did not introduce regressions in executed suites.
No blocking product/UI regression found in this scoped run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This run used provided EDGE_BASE_URL + EDGE_OPERATOR_JWT and verify:release returned OK_FULL. test_credentials.md contains no persistent test users and /app/auth_testing.md is currently missing in workspace.
rca of the issue: Jest act() warnings came from unmocked subpath imports ('@expo/vector-icons/Ionicons'). The existing global mock only intercepted '@expo/vector-icons'. Extending jest.setup.js with an explicit subpath mock removed warning noise while preserving green suites.
